title: Why Andrew Ryan built an underwater city in BioShock
subject: ryan
description:
Would you have moved to Rapture? 👇

How a boy who fled Minsk became the man who built Rapture. Spoilers for BioShock.

scenes.text: In 1919, a boy named Andrei Rianovsky fled Minsk for America.
The revolution took everything. In America he became Andrew Ryan, an industrial tycoon.
After Hiroshima, he swore no government would ever touch his work.
In 1946 he began building Rapture under the North Atlantic, hidden beneath a lonely lighthouse.
Newcomers rode down past a banner that read No gods or kings. Only man.
Then his recorded voice asked one question: Is a man not entitled to the sweat of his brow?
Ryan spent his life answering yes, until Rapture turned him into the tyrant he had run from.
